1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nf3 c5 4.cxd5 exd5 5.g.strategy: Completes the fianchetto. The bishop stands behind the f3-knight for now but aims at d5, and the pressure grows as soon as that knight steps aside; the king is also one move from castling. White plays patiently against the isolated pawn.

Guards d5 a second time and develops, so the pawn is covered when the g2-bishop's diagonal opens. Black heads for castling with a compact position; the isolated pawn must never be left short of protection.
